description.zh: 读取项目与任务、添加待办、修改截止时间与优先级并完成任务。适合随手把想法记成任务再统一安排。首次连接在浏览器登录 Todoist 授权。
description.en: Read projects and tasks, add to-dos, adjust due dates and priority, and complete tasks. Good for capturing ideas as tasks and sorting them later. Sign in to Todoist in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Todoist 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Todoist and authorize on first connect
